verdict.rationale: Windows is an OS, so whether it runs well on older hardware is a fair question. However, the evidence contains nothing showing that installing Windows on older hardware improves performance or extends device lifespan. The only hardware-related claims are about other things: one targets users with high-performance hardware (windows-docs-8), one covers a compatibility-checking app (windows-docs-15), and one covers paid security-update extensions for Windows 10 (windows-docs-34), none of which deliver this story.
